description: This file defines a Java class 'PyTorchAndroid' which provides static methods to initialize the PyTorch native library, load modules from assets, and configure threading parameters for the native code. It serves as an Android interface to interact with the PyTorch library and manage native dependencies.

classes.name: PyTorchAndroid
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for loading PyTorch modules and setting native configurations in an Android environment.

methods.name: loadModuleFromAsset
methods.description: Loads a PyTorch module from the app's assets, given an AssetManager, asset name, and optional device context. Returns a Module instance wrapping native resources.

methods.name: loadModuleFromAsset
methods.description: Overloaded version that loads a module from assets with default device set to CPU.

methods.name: setNumThreads
methods.description: Sets the number of threads for the native PyTorch execution, affecting all modules globally.
